body.name: SCC-local equation matrices and counts
body.construction: Let \(\operatorname{SCC}(B)\) be the strongly connected components of the directed support graph with arrow \(j\to i\) when \(B_{ij}\neq0\); for \(C\in\operatorname{SCC}(B)\), set \(W_C=W[C,C]\) and \(N_C=N_{\mathrm{stab}}(W_C)\).
